verdict.rationale: The docs show that many separate sandboxes can be created by ID, each in its own VM. The WebSocket transport is documented as avoiding subrequest limits during many concurrent operations, which is the only concurrency-related limit mentioned. Nothing documents fleet-scale concurrency, maximum concurrent sandbox counts or account quotas. Missing for 10: documented concurrent-sandbox/instance limits, fleet-scale orchestration guidance, independent evidence of running large concurrent fleets.
